slave 1 replied to "Read Holding Registers", but returned no data

── Byte-by-byte ──
00 01  Transaction identifier  Sequence number 0x0001 assigned by the master to this exchange; the response echoes it
00 00  Protocol identifier     0x0000 = standard Modbus protocol
00 03  Length                  3 more bytes follow (unit identifier + data)
01     Unit identifier         slave address: device 1
03     Function code           0x03 = Read Holding Registers
00     Byte count              0 data bytes

── Notes ──
The byte count is 0; the slave returned no data
